description: Source code implementation of the HttpAuthHandler class, which manages HTTP authentication challenges, token generation, and challenge handling within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP authentication challenges, token generation, and challenge responses.

methods.name: InitFromChallenge
methods.description: Initializes the handler from an authentication challenge, setting scheme, realm, score, and properties.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an authentication token based on provided credentials and request.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Indicates whether the handler needs an identity for authentication.

methods.name: AllowsDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Indicates if default credentials are allowed.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Indicates if explicit credentials are allowed.

methods.name: OnGenerateAuthTokenComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of auth token generation.

methods.name: FinishGenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Finalizes the token generation process, logging the result.
